Presenting TU KYA JANE O BEWAFA FULL VIDEO SONG from HAATH KI SAFAI movie starring Vinod Khanna, Hema Malini, Randhir Kapoor & Simi Garewal in lead roles, released on 1974. The song is sung by Lata Mangeshkar and music is given by Kalyanji-Anandji, music is available exclusively on Gaane Sune Ansune.
Song : TU KYA JANE O BEWAFA
Singer: LATA MANGESHKAR
Music Director: KALYANJI-ANANDJI
Lyricist: GULSHAN BAWRA
Vinod Khanna won the Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actor for this film.
